post.caption: Nicole Kidman's jeweler took a shop's name. Fred Leighton was born Murray Mondschein, a cab driver's son. He bought a Greenwich Village shop that sold Mexican dresses, and the shop was already called Fred Leighton, after its old owner. Customers kept asking for Fred Leighton, so he took the name. A dealer's Victorian pieces turned him toward antique jewelry, and he later moved the shop to Madison Avenue. In 1996, Miuccia Prada chose his opal choker for Kidman's first Oscars, and that loan began his habit of lending jewelry to stars. Natalie Portman later wore one of his headbands to the Oscars, and the Kwiat family bought the store in 2009.
